reasons.text: The preference tier Series B Preferred, Series B Preferred (from SAFEs) and Series B Preferred (from notes) is fully paid ($8,767,504.14). Above this exit value, the next dollar goes to the next tier's preference (Series A Preferred).
The preference tier Series A Preferred is fully paid ($4,000,000.00). Above this exit value, the next dollar goes to the next tier's preference (Seed Preferred).

Common reaches $0.00 per share, the strike on the 30,000 options at that price. Above this exit value they are in the money and exercised: their holders pay the strike, which is added to the proceeds, and share in the residual as common.
The preference tier Seed Preferred is fully paid ($2,925,000.00). Above this exit value, the next dollar goes to the residual, shared as common.

Common reaches $0.08 per share, the strike on the 150,000 options at that price. Above this exit value they are in the money and exercised: their holders pay the strike, which is added to the proceeds, and share in the residual as common.

Common reaches $0.10 per share, the strike on the 100,000 options at that price. Above this exit value they are in the money and exercised: their holders pay the strike, which is added to the proceeds, and share in the residual as common.

Series B Preferred (from notes) converts to common. At this exit value its as-converted share (440,082 common shares at $0.6079 each = $267,506.72) equals its 1x preference of $267,506.72. Below it, staying preferred pays more; above it, converting pays more.

Series B Preferred (from SAFEs) converts to common. At this exit value its as-converted share (734,404 common shares at $0.6808 each = $499,998.81) equals its 1x preference of $499,998.81. Below it, staying preferred pays more; above it, converting pays more.

Each Seed Preferred share is now worth $1.00, the strike on the warrant for 100,000 Seed Preferred shares. Above this exit value the warrant is in the money and exercised: its holder pays the strike, which is added to the proceeds, and the new shares join Seed Preferred, with its preference and conversion rights.

Seed Preferred converts to common. At this exit value its as-converted share (3,781,250 common shares at $0.8000 each = $3,025,000.00) equals its 1x preference of $3,025,000.00. Below it, staying preferred pays more; above it, converting pays more.

Series B Preferred converts to common. At this exit value its as-converted share (2,962,124 common shares at $2.7008 each = $7,999,998.61) equals its 1x preference of $7,999,998.61. Below it, staying preferred pays more; above it, converting pays more.

Series A Preferred reaches its cap: preference plus participation totals 3x its original issue price ($12,000,000.00). Above this exit value its payout stays flat until converting to common pays more.

Series A Preferred converts to common. At this exit value its as-converted share (2,000,000 common shares at $6.0000 each = $12,000,000.00) equals its capped payout of $12,000,000.00 (3x its original issue price). Below it, staying preferred pays more; above it, converting pays more.
